title: Fall
subtitle: 「跌倒／倒下／墜落」，究竟是哪一種 fall？
description: 「跌倒／倒下／墜落」，究竟是哪一種 fall？

words.note: 表示失去平衡後跌倒，常帶有翻滾、凌亂或突然的動作感。
words.example: He tumbled down the slope and landed in the grass.
words.exampleZh: 他從斜坡翻滾跌下，最後落在草地上。

exercises.original: He fell down the grassy slope, rolling several times before stopping.
exercises.zh: 他從草坡跌下，翻滾了幾圈才停下來。
exercises.upgrade: tumbled · 跌倒；翻滾而下；摔倒

options.explanation: rolling several times 是決定性線索；tumble 表示失控地跌下並常伴隨翻滾。
trip 通常表示腳被東西絆到，原句沒有障礙物，而且重點是沿斜坡翻滾。
slip 需要濕滑／光滑等失去摩擦力線索，原句沒有。
collapse 通常是身體因虛弱突然倒下，或結構崩塌，不表示沿坡翻滾。
drop 更適合物件從高處落下，不自然描述人在坡上翻滾。
過去分詞不能單獨作一般過去式；應為 fell 或 had fallen。

exercises.original: The child fell off the low bank and rolled into the leaves below.
exercises.zh: 孩子從矮土坡跌下，翻滾進下面的落葉堆。

options.explanation: rolled into the leaves 明確帶翻滾感，tumble 比普通 fall 更生動精確。
stumble 只是短暫腳步不穩，不一定離開地面翻滾。
沒有被障礙物絆到的線索。
rolled 顯示失控，gentle 語氣不合。
不表示從 bank 翻下。
句子需要一般過去式 tumbled。

exercises.original: Several boxes fell from the shelf in a messy heap.
exercises.zh: 幾個箱子從架上亂七八糟地翻落下來。

options.explanation: boxes + messy heap 表示多個物件不整齊地翻落，tumble 很自然。
stumble 通常用人或有腳步的主體。
可以指滑落，但原句重點是凌亂翻落成一堆。

words.note: 表示腳被障礙物勾住或絆到而失去平衡。trip 本身不一定真的跌到地上。
words.example: She tripped over the cable but managed not to fall.
words.exampleZh: 她被電線絆了一下，但沒有真的跌倒。

exercises.original: She nearly fell when her foot caught on the loose cable.
exercises.zh: 她的腳被鬆脫電線絆到，差點跌倒。

options.explanation: foot caught on the cable 是 trip 的典型原因，且原句說 nearly fell，正好說明 trip 不一定真的跌倒。
slip 是腳底失去摩擦力，不是被物件絆到。
通常因身體狀況突然倒下。
偏整個直立主體翻倒，不特別指出「腳被絆住」。
表示劇烈向下墜落，力度過強。

exercises.original: He fell forward after catching his toe on the raised edge of the pavement.
exercises.zh: 他的腳趾勾到凸起的行人路邊緣後向前跌倒。

options.explanation: catching his toe on 是最明確的 trip 線索；先被絆到，再向前跌。
沒有濕滑表面或失去摩擦力。
人通常不說 dropped 表示絆倒。

exercises.original: She almost fell after stepping on the trailing strap of her bag.
exercises.zh: 她踩到袋子的拖帶後差點被絆倒。

options.explanation: strap 是障礙物，且她只是 almost fell，trip 精確表示絆到但未必倒地。
almost fell 表明她沒有完全倒下。

words.note: 非常常見、日常，通常指人或直立物失去平衡後倒下。
words.example: The child fell over while running.

exercises.original: The child fell while running across the playground.
exercises.zh: 孩子在遊樂場跑步時跌倒了。

options.explanation: 沒有提供具體原因，只表示跑步時失去平衡倒地；日常 British English 用 fall over 很自然。
原句沒有障礙物，不能憑空加入 trip 的原因。

exercises.original: The chair fell when one of its legs broke.
exercises.zh: 椅子其中一隻腳斷掉後倒下了。

options.explanation: 直立物失去支撐倒下，用 fall over 自然。
椅子不會因「腳被絆」而 trip。
除非整張椅子在滑面移動，否則不合。
不是人因健康問題倒下。

exercises.original: Be careful on the uneven ground or you may fall.
exercises.zh: 在不平地面上要小心，否則可能跌倒。

options.explanation: 一般失去平衡的警告，不需要指定 trip/slip 原因。
通常更嚴重，常有身體虛弱或結構失效原因。
modal may 後用原形 fall。

words.note: 表示短暫失去平衡、腳步不穩，可能恢復平衡而沒有真正跌倒。
words.example: He stumbled on the uneven pavement but stayed upright.
words.exampleZh: 他在不平路面上踉蹌了一下，但仍站穩了。

exercises.original: He almost fell on the uneven pavement but managed to regain his balance.
exercises.zh: 他在不平行人路上踉蹌了一下，但恢復了平衡。
exercises.upgrade: stumbled · 踉蹌；絆了一下；失足

options.explanation: regain his balance 表明只是短暫失衡而未完全跌倒，這是 stumble 的核心。
表示整個人倒下，通常不會立刻以「regain balance」描述。
almost fell 與 completely 矛盾。

exercises.original: She briefly lost her balance on the step but did not hit the ground.
exercises.zh: 她在台階上短暫失去平衡，但沒有跌到地上。

options.explanation: brief loss of balance + did not hit the ground 精確描述 stumble。

exercises.original: The runner nearly fell after landing awkwardly but continued without stopping.
exercises.zh: 跑手落腳不穩後踉蹌了一下，但沒有停下。

options.explanation: continued without stopping 表明他很快恢復平衡，stumble 最合適。
通常會倒地且無法繼續。
會暗示翻滾跌倒，原句只是 nearly fell。

words.note: 表示因表面濕滑、光滑或腳下失去摩擦力而失去平衡。
words.example: She slipped on the wet floor and hurt her wrist.
words.exampleZh: 她在濕滑地板上滑倒，弄傷了手腕。

exercises.original: She fell on the wet tiles outside the swimming pool.
exercises.zh: 她在泳池外的濕滑瓷磚上滑倒。

options.explanation: wet tiles 是典型 loss-of-traction 線索，因此 slip 最精確。

exercises.original: He almost fell on the ice but caught the railing.
exercises.zh: 他在冰面上滑了一下，差點跌倒，但抓住欄杆。

options.explanation: ice 是最明確的滑倒原因，而 caught the railing 顯示未必真正倒地。
與 caught the railing 不符。

exercises.original: The waiter fell after stepping on a patch of spilled oil.
exercises.zh: 侍應踩到一灘油後滑倒。

options.explanation: oil reduces friction；slip on oil 是自然搭配。
只說腳步不穩，沒有突出滑面原因。
憑空加入不存在的障礙物。
拼寫錯誤；過去式是 slipped。

words.note: 常用於高而直立的人或物體失去平衡後整個倒下。
words.example: The strong wind toppled the tree.

exercises.original: The old tree fell in the storm after its roots loosened.
exercises.zh: 老樹的根鬆脫後，在暴風雨中倒下。

options.explanation: upright tree + roots loosened 表示整棵失去平衡翻倒，topple 非常自然。

exercises.original: The tall cabinet fell forward when the floor shifted.
exercises.zh: 地板移動時，高櫃向前翻倒。

options.explanation: tall upright cabinet losing balance 是典型 topple。
可整體滑動但不表示翻倒。

exercises.original: The statue fell from its base during the earthquake.
exercises.zh: 地震期間，雕像從底座翻倒。

options.explanation: statue 是高而直立的物體，失去底座平衡後翻倒，topple 最精確。

words.note: 表示人因虛弱、疾病或疲勞突然倒下，或建築／結構失去支撐而倒塌。
words.example: He collapsed from exhaustion after the race.
words.exampleZh: 賽跑後他因筋疲力盡而倒下。

exercises.original: He suddenly fell after the race because he was completely exhausted.
exercises.zh: 賽跑後他因筋疲力盡突然倒下。

options.explanation: completely exhausted 是典型身体虛弱導致突然倒下的線索，collapse 比 ordinary fall 更強。
可描述整個人倒下，但不如 collapse 表達因虛弱失去支撐。

exercises.original: Part of the roof fell after the supporting beam broke.
exercises.zh: 支撐樑斷裂後，部分屋頂倒塌。

options.explanation: supporting beam failure 是 structural collapse 的典型原因。
屋頂不是凌亂翻滾物件，且 casual 語氣不合。

exercises.original: She fell to the floor after feeling faint and weak.
exercises.zh: 她感到暈眩和虛弱後倒在地上。

options.explanation: faint and weak 直接支持 health-related collapse。

words.note: 表示快速、劇烈地向下墜落，常從高處或進入水中。
words.example: The car plunged down the embankment.

exercises.original: The car fell down the steep embankment after leaving the road.
exercises.zh: 汽車離開道路後猛然衝下陡峭路堤。

options.explanation: steep embankment + car leaving road 指快速、劇烈向下移動，plunge 很精確。
力度太弱，且不是單純滑動。

exercises.original: The climber fell several metres into the ravine when the rope failed.
exercises.zh: 繩索斷裂後，攀登者猛然墜入山溝數米。

options.explanation: several metres + into ravine 是劇烈垂直墜落，plunge 很自然。
與實際墜入 ravine 矛盾。

exercises.original: The branch broke and the backpack fell into the river below.
exercises.zh: 樹枝斷裂，背包猛然墜入下方河中。

options.explanation: into the river below 表示快速向下進入另一個空間／液體，plunge 很生動。

words.note: 表示由較高位置向下移動或落下，可主動、被動或因失手。
words.example: The phone dropped from his hand onto the floor.
words.exampleZh: 手機從他手中掉到地板上。

exercises.original: The phone fell from his hand onto the floor.
exercises.zh: 手機從他手中掉到地板上。

options.explanation: hand-held object + onto floor 是典型 drop movement。
手機不是高直立物翻倒。

exercises.original: One of the books fell from the top shelf.
exercises.zh: 其中一本書從最上層書架掉下來。

options.explanation: 單一物件從較高位置落下，用 drop 簡潔自然。
可以文學化誇張，但一本書從 shelf 掉下通常不需這麼強。

exercises.original: A coin fell out of his pocket as he stood up.
exercises.zh: 他站起來時，一枚硬幣從口袋掉了出來。

options.explanation: small object leaving pocket and falling downward 是典型 drop。
硬幣不是直立大型物體翻倒。
現代標準過去式是 dropped。

words.note: 較口語，可表示人、物件或結構倒下；具體含義依上下文而定。
words.example: The cyclist went down after hitting the pothole.
words.exampleZh: 單車手撞到坑洞後倒地。

exercises.original: The cyclist fell after hitting a deep pothole.
exercises.zh: 單車手撞到深坑後倒地。
exercises.upgrade: went down · 倒下；跌下；倒地

options.explanation: cycling/sport accident context 中，go down 是常見口語說法，表示騎手倒地。
騎單車時不是腳被障礙物絆住的典型 trip。
把人當物件，語感不自然。
一般過去式需要 went down；gone down 需 have/has/had。

exercises.original: Two players fell during the collision, but neither was seriously hurt.
exercises.zh: 碰撞中兩名球員倒地，但都沒有嚴重受傷。

options.explanation: sport collision 中 players went down 是自然口語表達，未指定更具體原因。
原因被無根據改成疲勞。

exercises.original: The boxer fell after a hard punch but got back up quickly.
exercises.zh: 拳手被重拳擊中後倒下，但很快站起來。

options.explanation: boxing context 中 go down 是固定自然說法，表示被擊倒。

words.note: 表示腳沒有踩穩而失去平衡，尤其在樓梯、山路、邊緣或濕滑表面。
words.example: She lost her footing on the steep path.

exercises.original: She fell on the steep path when one foot failed to find a secure place.
exercises.zh: 她在陡峭小路上因腳沒有踩穩而失足。
exercises.upgrade: lost her footing · 失足；腳下不穩

options.explanation: failed to find a secure place 幾乎直接定義 footing：腳沒有穩定落點。
既沒有刻意，也不是重點。

exercises.original: He fell while climbing the wet stone steps because his foot could not grip securely.
exercises.zh: 他爬濕石階時因腳無法穩穩踩住而失足。

options.explanation: climbing + foot not secure 是 footing-specific context；比只說 slipped 更聚焦「沒有踩穩」。

exercises.original: The hiker fell near the edge after stepping onto loose gravel.
exercises.zh: 行山者踩到鬆散碎石後在邊緣附近失足。

options.explanation: loose gravel makes secure footing difficult，這個片語自然描述腳下不穩。
碎石是表面不穩，不是明確固定障礙物。
只有真正跌下邊緣時才合；原句只說 near the edge。

words.note: 較口語的名詞式表達，強調實際發生了一次跌倒。
words.example: He took a nasty fall on the stairs.
words.exampleZh: 他在樓梯上重重摔了一跤。

exercises.original: He fell badly on the stairs and bruised his shoulder.
exercises.zh: 他在樓梯上重重摔了一跤，肩膀瘀傷。
exercises.upgrade: took a nasty fall · 重重摔了一跤

options.explanation: bruise + stairs 表示一次實際而不輕的跌倒事件，take a nasty fall 很自然。
trip 不一定真的倒地，無法充分解釋 bruised shoulder。
與受傷的完整跌倒事件不符。
過度劇烈，樓梯跌倒不一定是 plunge。
固定表達是 take a fall。

exercises.original: She fell while getting off the bus but was able to stand up again immediately.
exercises.zh: 她下巴士時跌了一跤，但立即能重新站起來。
exercises.upgrade: took a fall · 跌了一跤

options.explanation: 描述一次已完成的跌倒事件，語氣自然口語。
通常暗示健康／虛弱或更嚴重突然倒下。

exercises.original: Older hikers should use poles because a fall on this rocky section could cause injury.
exercises.zh: 年長行山者應使用行山杖，因為在這段多石路面摔一跤可能受傷。

options.explanation: 介詞/從句位置需要 gerund phrase；語義是一整次跌倒事件。
缺少助動詞，不能作主語。

words.note: 表示身體突然失去平衡並向前倒。
words.example: He caught his foot on the step and pitched forward.
words.exampleZh: 他的腳卡在台階上，整個人向前栽倒。

exercises.original: His foot caught on the step and he fell forward with both hands out in front of him.
exercises.zh: 他的腳卡在台階上，整個人雙手向前伸着栽倒。
exercises.upgrade: pitched forward · 向前栽倒；猛然向前跌

options.explanation: foot caught + hands out front 明確指定突然向前跌的方向。

exercises.original: The cyclist hit the kerb and fell forward over the handlebars.
exercises.zh: 單車手撞到路緣後，整個人越過車把向前栽倒。

options.explanation: over the handlebars 明確是向前猛跌。
不是垂直落下，而是向前拋出。
原句明確越過車把倒下。

exercises.original: She lost balance when the bus stopped suddenly and fell forward into the seat ahead.
exercises.zh: 巴士突然停下時她失去平衡，向前猛跌到前面的座位。

options.explanation: sudden stop + into seat ahead 清楚指定向前快速失衡。

words.note: 生動、強烈，表示人或物件伴隨巨大力量、聲響或破壞倒下。
words.example: Part of the ceiling came crashing down.

exercises.original: Part of the ceiling fell with a loud crash during the storm.
exercises.zh: 暴風雨期間，部分天花板轟然倒下。
exercises.upgrade: came crashing down · 轟然倒下；猛然墜落

options.explanation: loud crash + falling structure 是這個強烈慣用表達的典型語境。

exercises.original: The weakened wall fell suddenly, sending bricks across the pavement.
exercises.zh: 已受損的牆突然轟然倒下，磚塊散落行人路。
exercises.upgrade: came crashing down · 轟然倒下

options.explanation: wall + sudden structural fall + bricks scattered 表示有力量、聲響與破壞。
標準固定表達是 came crashing down。

exercises.original: A large branch fell onto the roof with enough force to break several tiles.
exercises.zh: 一根大樹枝猛然墜到屋頂上，力量大得打破數塊瓦片。
exercises.upgrade: came crashing down · 猛然墜落

options.explanation: enough force to break tiles 是強烈撞擊線索，come crashing down 最生動精確。
drift 表示輕柔飄落，與破瓦力量相反。
詞序不自然；固定說法是 came crashing down。

falseSynonyms.zh: trip 描述失去平衡的原因；一個人可以 trip but not fall。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She tripped over a bag but stayed on her feet. A moment later, another runner fell to the ground.

falseSynonyms.zh: stumble 不一定完成整個跌倒動作。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He stumbled on the uneven path and recovered. He later fell and injured his knee.

falseSynonyms.zh: slip 的核心是失去摩擦力；fall 只說結果。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She slipped on the ice. She fell and landed on her side.

falseSynonyms.zh: 人可以因疾病、虛弱而 collapse；建築物也可因結構失效 collapse。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He fell while stepping off the kerb. He collapsed from exhaustion after the race.

falseSynonyms.zh: drop 不通常描述一個成年人失去平衡跌倒，除非是特定結構如 drop to the ground。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The glass dropped from her hand. She fell on the wet floor.

falseSynonyms.zh: 樹、雕像、架子或高物件很常 topple；人也可以，但語感較具「整個翻倒」。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The old wall toppled in the storm. The child fell while running.

falseSynonyms.zh: fall 通常包含失去控制或意外；lie down 是自主動作。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He felt tired and lay down on the bed. He lost his balance and fell on the floor.

falseSynonyms.zh: fall 是原形；fell 是過去式；fallen 是過去分詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Be careful not to fall. She fell yesterday. A tree had fallen across the road.
